known_issues: Regression: chart editing not available/working in the latest version; user requests reverting to the last version where chart editing works.

existing_features.title: Re-enable the Admin Callaway chart editor UI so that when Admin Access is enabled, the /admin page shows the editable chart interface instead of a locked “backend-managed chart” message.

Restore chart editing functionality end-to-end by making the scoring calculations and chart display use the locally editable Callaway chart (from the localStorage-backed chart persistence layer) so user edits affect results.
Ensure the app no longer presents the Callaway chart as backend-locked/centrally managed, and remove any UI copy that implies chart edits require contacting a system administrator.
